lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੂਅਰ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar agan na gur bin boojhai baahar pooar taapai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, the fire within is not quenched; and outside, the fire still burns.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa bin bhagat na hovee kiu kar cheenas aapai ||
lines.translation: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship. How can anyone, by himself, know the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa kar kar narak nivaasee a(n)tar aatam jaapai ||
lines.translation: Slandering others, one lives in hell; within him is hazy darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਪਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath bharam vigoochahi kiu mal dhopai paapai ||3||
lines.translation: Wandering to the eixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, he is ruined. How can the filth of sin be washed away? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਾਣੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhaanee khaak bibhoot chaRaaee maaiaa kaa mag johai ||
lines.translation: He sifts through the dust, and applies ashes to his body, but he is searching for the path of Maya's wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੇ ਤੇ ਛੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ek na jaanai saach kahe te chhohai ||
lines.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, he does not know the One Lord; if someone tells him the Truth, he grows angry.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਓਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paath paRai mukh jhootho bolai nigure kee mat ohai ||
lines.translation: He reads the scriptures, but tells lies; such is the intellect of one who has no guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਈ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naam na japaee kiu sukh paavai bin naavai kiu sohai ||4||
lines.translation: Without chanting the Naam, how can he find peace? Without the Name, how can he look good? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂੰਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇ ਜਟਾ ਸਿਖ ਬਾਧੀ ਮੋਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: moo(n)d mudaai jataa sikh baadhee mon rahai abhimaanaa ||
lines.translation: Some shave their heads, some keep their hair in matted tangles; some keep it in braids, while some keep silent, filled with egotistical pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਤ ਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manooaa dolai dah dis dhaavai bin rat aatam giaanaa ||
lines.translation: Their minds waver and wander in ten directions, without loving devotion and enlightenment of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit chhod mahaa bikh peevai maaiaa kaa devaanaa ||
lines.translation: They abandon the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink the deadly poison, driven mad by Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਸੂਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kirat na mitaee hukam na boojhai pasooaa maahi samaanaa ||5||
lines.translation: Past actions cannot be erased; without understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they become beasts. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: haath kama(n)dal kaapaReeaa man trisanaa upajee bhaaree ||
lines.translation: With bowl in hand, wearing his patched coat, great desires well up in his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: isatree taj kar kaam viaapiaa chit laaiaa par naaree ||
lines.translation: Abandoning his own wife, he is engrossed in sexual desire; his thoughts are on the wives of others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਲੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sikh kare kar sabad na cheenai la(n)pat hai baajaaree ||
lines.translation: He teaches and preaches, but does not contemplate the Shabad; he is bought and sold on the street.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar bikh baahar nibharaatee taa jam kare khuaaree ||6||
lines.translation: With poison within, he pretends to be free of doubt; he is ruined and humiliated by the Messenger of Death. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sa(n)niaasee jo satigur sevai vichahu aap gavaae ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Sannyaasi, who serves the True Guru, and removes his self-conceit from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਕਰਈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhaadan bhojan kee aas na karaee achi(n)t milai so paae ||
lines.translation: He does not ask for clothes or food; without asking, he accepts whatever he receives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bakai na bolai khimaa dhan sa(n)grahai taamas naam jalaae ||
lines.translation: He does not speak empty words; he gathers in the wealth of tolerance, and burns away his anger with the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: dhan girahee sa(n)niaasee jogee j har charanee chit laae ||7||
lines.translation: Blessed is such a householder, Sannyaasi and Yogi, who focuses his consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aas niraas rahai sa(n)niaasee ekas siu liv laae ||
lines.translation: Amidst hope, the Sannyaasi remains unmoved by hope; he remains lovingly focused on the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras peevai taa saat aavai nij ghar taaRee laae ||
lines.translation: He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord, and so finds peace and tranquility; in the home of his own being, he remains absorbed in the deep trance of meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: manooaa na dolai guramukh boojhai dhaavat varaj rahaae ||
lines.translation: His mind does not waver; as Gurmukh, he understands. He restrains it from wandering out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: grihu sareer guramatee khoje naam padaarath paae ||8||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, he searches the home of his body, and obtains the wealth of the Naam. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes saresat naam rate veechaaree ||
lines.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are exalted, imbued with contemplative meditation on the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਗਨ ਪਤਾਲੀ ਜੰਤਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaanee baanee gagan pataalee ja(n)taa jot tumaaree ||
lines.translation: The sources of creation, speech, the heavens and the underworld, all beings and creatures, are infused with Your Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh mukat naam dhun baanee sach naam ur dhaaree ||
lines.translation: All comforts and liberation are found in the Naam, and the vibrations of the Guru's Bani; I have enshrined the True Name within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੯॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa nahee chhootas naanak saachee tar too taaree ||9||7||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, no one is saved; O Nanak, with the Truth, cross over to the other side. ||9||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa sa(n)jog upaae rakat bi(n)d mil pi(n)d kare ||
lines.translation: Through the union of mother and father, the fetus is formed. The egg and sperm join together to make the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਉਰਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar garabh uradh liv laagee so prabh saare daat kare ||1||
lines.translation: Upside-down within the womb, it lovingly dwells on the Lord; God provides for it, and gives it nourishment there. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar bhavajal kiu tarai ||
lines.translation: How can he cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰੁ ਟਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam nira(n)jan paaeeai aphario bhaar aphaar tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unbearable load of sins is removed. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਉ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: te gun visar gae aparaadhee mai bauraa kiaa karau hare ||
lines.translation: I have forgotten Your Virtues, Lord; I am insane - what can I do now?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too daataa daiaal sabhai sir ahinis daat samaar kare ||2||
lines.translation: You are the Merciful Giver, above the heads of all. Day and night, You give gifts, and take care of all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲੈ ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath lai jag janamiaa siv sakatee ghar vaas dhare ||
lines.translation: One is born to achieve the four great objectives of life. The spirit has taken up its home in the material world.
